Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFPadesOptions

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class CPDFPadesOptions extends Object implements Cloneable
Settings for PKCS#12 PAdES signing and LTV prolongation.

CPDFPadesSigner.sign(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions) uses the selected profile, signer, field, appearance, evidence and timestamp settings. CPDFPadesSigner.prolongLtv(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions) uses evidence collection, trust anchors and document-timestamp settings; it does not create another approval signature or use the PKCS#12 signer. For prolongation, setAppendDocumentTimestamp(boolean) selects LT versus LTA.

Defaults select profile B, a visible field with an empty rectangle and appearance, automatic LTV collection, and post-sign verification. Set a valid rectangle or disable visibility before signing. Certificate and TSA paths are initially empty.

Setters return this instance and copy mutable arrays/options where applicable. Do not mutate an instance concurrently with submitting an operation.

    • setValidationOptions

      public CPDFPadesOptions setValidationOptions(CPDFSignatureValidationOptions options)
      Sets checks for verification immediately after the signing stage.

      The settings are copied and forwarded to the inner signature workflow. The field filter is not forwarded. LT/LTA final verification and prolongation use the PAdES workflow's own verification settings; use CPDFSignatureValidator for an independent final-file validation.

      Parameters:
      options - the validation settings; null restores the defaults
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setField

      public CPDFPadesOptions setField(int pageIndex, RectF rect)
      Places the signature field.

      The rectangle is in PDF page space, where y grows upwards — so top is the larger value, unlike a screen-space RectF. A visible signature needs a non-empty rectangle.

      Parameters:
      pageIndex - the zero-based page index; default is 0
      rect - the rectangle in PDF page coordinates; null preserves the current rectangle
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setEstimatedContentsSize

      public CPDFPadesOptions setEstimatedContentsSize(int estimatedContentsSize)
      Reserves space for the signature container.

      Zero lets the core decide. Raise it if signing fails because the PKCS#7 blob — an embedded timestamp makes it considerably larger — does not fit the reserved /Contents.

      Parameters:
      estimatedContentsSize - the container capacity in bytes; 0 uses the core default; negative values are rejected
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setVerifyAfterSign

      public CPDFPadesOptions setVerifyAfterSign(boolean verifyAfterSign)
      Controls verification by the inner signature creation workflow.

      Defaults to true. This switch does not disable the PAdES workflow's final LT/LTA verification and is not used by CPDFPadesSigner.prolongLtv(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions). Inspect CPDFPadesResult.getValidationResult() for the returned verdict.

      Parameters:
      verifyAfterSign - true to verify immediately after the signing stage
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setTsaUrl

      public CPDFPadesOptions setTsaUrl(String tsaUrl)
      Sets the RFC 3161 endpoint for the embedded signature timestamp.

      Required when signing profiles T, LT or LTA. It also supplies the fallback document-timestamp endpoint when setLtaTsaUrl(String) is empty, including during prolongation. Prolongation cannot add a missing embedded signature timestamp.

      Parameters:
      tsaUrl - an HTTP or HTTPS TSA URL; null clears it
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

      False targets LT; true targets LTA and requires a reachable TSA and a separate LTA output path. The output must still pass validation to satisfy that target. Ignored by CPDFPadesSigner.sign(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String, com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFPadesOptions), where setProfile(Profile) selects the output stages.

      Parameters:
      appendDocumentTimestamp - true to append a document timestamp; default is false
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setTrustedCertPath

      public CPDFPadesOptions setTrustedCertPath(String trustedCertPath)
      Sets trust anchors for certificate-chain building and PAdES verification.

      Automatic evidence collection needs a chain that can be built to a trusted root. Supply anchors for the signer and any TSA whose trust must be verified. Native verification uses OpenSSL trust anchors rather than the JVM trust store. A self-signed test CA is trusted only when explicitly included.

      Parameters:
      trustedCertPath - a PEM trust bundle or OpenSSL hashed certificate directory; null clears it
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setRevocationUrls

      public CPDFPadesOptions setRevocationUrls(String[] ocspUrls, String[] crlUrls)
      Sets explicit sources from which automatic collection obtains revocation evidence.

      Null or empty arrays let the collector use the certificates' AIA/CRL distribution-point information. Nonempty arrays supply explicit URLs. Both arrays are copied; modifying them afterward does not change the settings.

      Parameters:
      ocspUrls - OCSP responder URLs, or null/empty to use certificate information
      crlUrls - CRL download URLs, or null/empty to use certificate information
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration

    • setAutoCollectLtvValidationInfo

      public CPDFPadesOptions setAutoCollectLtvValidationInfo(boolean autoCollectLtvValidationInfo)
      Controls automatic collection of certificate chains and OCSP/CRL evidence.

      Keep this enabled for LT/LTA creation and prolongation. This binding does not expose an alternative API to supply pre-collected evidence bytes, so disabling collection can leave required material unavailable and the target unsatisfied.

      Parameters:
      autoCollectLtvValidationInfo - true to collect evidence automatically; default is true
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration
